author: claude
summary: Task 005 of the voice-card-consolidation plan: relocates TestSection under VoiceLabPage's Test tabpanel and folds ScriptEditor.tsx's test-text editing UI (variant name, engine select, reference sample/asset id, the 'Suggest from voice qualities' button -- unchanged, still the only caller of suggestRecordingPrompt() -- reset, save) directly into the same tab, retiring the ScriptEditor drawer for this in-page flow. VariantsTab's 'Script' button now switches VoiceLabPage to the Test tab instead of opening a drawer, requiring VoiceDetailTabs to gain an optional controlled-tab mode.

files.change: New: composes TestSection (unchanged, relocated) with ScriptEditor (reused directly, no Drawer wrapper) sharing the same 'active profile' via TestSection's new onActiveProfileChange callback. Implements its own save/reset handlers (POST /api/speaker-profiles/{name}/settings, /reset-test-text, /variant-name, /rename) mirroring useVoicesTabActions.ts's handleSaveTestText/handleResetTestText exactly, since VoiceLabPage doesn't share that hook (scoped to the legacy VoicesPage catalog tab).

Added optional onActiveProfileChange?: (profile) => void prop, fired via useEffect keyed on the selected variant's name -- lets TestTab keep its folded-in ScriptEditor fields in sync with whichever variant the 'Variant' dropdown has selected. No change to existing behavior/props otherwise.

Added optional controlled-mode props (activeTabId, onTabChange), backward-compatible with the existing fully-uncontrolled mode (no existing callers/tests pass these, all continue to pass). Lets VoiceLabPage switch tabs programmatically from outside the tablist.

Un-omitted onEditTestText from VariantsTabProps (previously Omit<VariantsSectionProps, 'onEditTestText'> with a TODO(task 005) comment left by task 004) so it now passes through to VariantsSection/VariantEditor's 'Script' button.

Lifted activeTabId state, passed as VoiceDetailTabs' controlled activeTabId/onTabChange. Wired TestTab as the Test tabpanel (profiles/engines/testProgress/jobs/onTest/onRefresh/voiceName/attributes). Wired VariantsTab's onEditTestText={() => setActiveTabId('test')}. Replaced remaining _testProgress-underscore stub with the real testProgress/jobs props (now read by TestTab).

Added two tests: (1) Test tab renders TestSection's variant picker plus the folded-in ScriptEditor content (variant-name helper text, 'Suggest from voice qualities' button) and no longer shows a separate 'Edit preview script' link; (2) clicking the Variants tab's 'Script' button switches the active tab to Test (no dialog opens). R1 revert-check performed manually (temporarily reverted the Test-tabpanel wiring/onEditTestText prop back to the task-004 placeholder state) -- both new tests failed for the right reason, then passed again after restoring.

flagged_deviations: Task 005's acceptance criterion 'No remaining UI path opens the old ScriptEditor drawer' is satisfied for every path inside VoiceLabPage (TestSection's former 'Edit preview script' link, and VariantEditor's Script button as used in VoiceLabPage's Variants tab). It is NOT satisfied for the separate legacy VoicesPage catalog tab's 'Edit Recording Script' overflow-menu item, which still opens the ScriptEditor drawer via VoicesModals.tsx -- that catalog page and its drawer wiring are outside task 005's 'Exact files' list and are explicitly task 006's (P6, card simplification) territory per 01-map.md ('Edit Recording Script ... removed from the card menu entirely'). Retiring it now would require cross-page tab-selection routing not scoped to this task and would risk duplicating/pre-empting task 006's explicit mandate. Flagging this gap for task 006 to close rather than silently leaving it undiscovered.
